title: Ashura- the 10th of Muharram
body:
Between Dhuhr and Asr:
- Pray 4 Rakaats. In each Rakaat recite one time Fatiha and
ten times Ikhlas
-Make Dhikr:
-1ooo x La ilaha ill’Allah
-1ooo x Salawat
-1ooo x Ikhlas
DUA :
Allahumma thabitna ala’l Haqq,
Ya Ghaliban ghaira maghlub,
Ya Nasira’l Mu’miniin,
Ya Ghiyatha’l Mustaghithiin,
Ya Qariban ghaira ba’id,

Ya Shahidan ghaira mashhud,
Hasbi Allahu wa niamal Wakil, la haula wa la quwatta illa
bi’llahi’l Aliyu’l ‘Azim,
ghufranaka, Rabbana, wa ilayka’l masir...
Rabbana taqabbal minna, bi hurmati’l Habib...
Fatiha.
- 01.04.1999
